lanes.name: Strait of Hormuz
lanes.text: Restricted since Feb 28. Nov 16: UKMTO says an outbound vessel was hit by an unknown projectile and had an engine-room fire, crew safe; Iran's IRGC says two tankers hit mines and Iran's navy says a vessel is ablaze after hitting a mine, with no independent confirmation. Nov 14: Iran said three tankers hit mines. UKMTO counted at least seven tanker attacks in the week to Nov 11 and puts transits about 65% below pre-war. The UN says at least 25 seafarers have died since February. The US says routes are cleared and the strait is open; Iran says it stays shut until its conditions are met. Al Jazeera reports a third US carrier, USS Theodore Roosevelt, reached the region on Nov 16 (a US official; not formally confirmed).

stats.asOfNote: UKMTO weekly overview to Nov 11; IMO to Nov 11

rows.value: Transits about 65% below pre-war: 139 outbound, 169 inbound last week vs 170 and 155 the week before; threat level severe; 163 conflict-related incidents since Feb 28
At least 25 seafarers killed in and around Hormuz since February; 136 security incidents Mar 1-Nov 11 (35 in October, 10 so far in November)
Says main routes are cleared of mines and the strait is open
Requires approval to transit; says the strait stays shut until its conditions are met

stats.note: Counts from different monitors are not comparable. UKMTO page itself was blocked; figures are as relayed by Middle East Eye. Red Sea: UKMTO reports no attacks since Aug 24; Bab al-Mandab transits about 24% below pre-blockade levels.

stats.label: Other energy & transport signals
stats.text: Houthi attacks have grounded nearly 90% of flights at Riyadh airport (Reuters, via Al Jazeera on X, Oct 29). Air France extended its Riyadh and Dubai suspension. QatarEnergy is buying US LNG to hedge Hormuz disruption (Reuters on X, Oct 29). Pentagon told lawmakers the war has cost at least $47.1bn (via Al Jazeera on X).
